commands.cmd: shell ps -A -o PID,ARGS | grep -F 'thermal_zone' | grep -v grep

et_loop.command: while true; do cat /proc/uptime; dumpsys thermalservice | sed -n '/Current temperatures from HAL/,/Current cooling devices/p'; for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do echo $z $(cat $z/type 2>&1) $(cat $z/temp 2>&1); done; done
